candidateName.title: Candidate name
candidateName.description: Full or partial candidate name to search for (e.g. "Warren" or "Elizabeth Warren"). Leave empty and use state/office/party filters alone to browse instead of searching by name.

state.title: State (2-letter code)
state.description: Restrict to candidates running in this state, e.g. "CA", "TX". Leave empty for all states.

party.title: Party code
party.description: Restrict to one party code, e.g. "DEM", "REP", "IND", "LIB". Leave empty for all parties.

electionYear.title: Election cycle year
electionYear.description: Restrict to candidates active in this even-numbered election cycle, e.g. 2024. Leave empty for all cycles.

includeTotals.title: Include financial totals
includeTotals.description: For each candidate found, fetch their campaign financial totals (receipts, disbursements, cash on hand, individual contributions) from the FEC's totals endpoint. Adds one extra request per candidate.
